hooks.command: $json = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $obj = $json | ConvertFrom-Json; $file = if ($obj.tool_response.filePath) { $obj.tool_response.filePath } else { $obj.tool_input.file_path }; if ($file -match '\.py$') { $output = ((& flake8 $file 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" }) -join "`n").Trim(); if ($output) { Write-Output (@{ systemMessage = "flake8 `n$output"; continue = $true } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) } }
